wiki.notes: All 9 harvested wiki citations for P3242 were opened/checked. bit.ly/2smVBv2 resolves to abarrelfull.wikidot.com (BANNED, excluded). kindermorgan.com/.../FGT/default.aspx is a confirmed 404 (dead). oilandgaswatch.org/pipeline/6491 is a JS SPA, unreadable via curl (blocked, not confirmed dead). The remaining live pages (energytransfer.com ipost FGT system map, fractracker.org national map, eia.gov/maps/layer_info-m.php, a 2018 Pipeline News 'Planned Projects' PDF, a 2018 Texas Energy Report blog post about FGT's unrelated 'East-West Pipeline Expansion') are all general/off-target and none name this specific ~2.6-3 mi lateral. None of the 9 were usable as citations. The one useful lead in the pool was eia.gov/naturalgas/data.php, which pointed to EIA's structured 'Natural Gas Pipeline Projects' historical dataset -- that dataset (found independently, not one of the 9 URLs) plus an independent SEC EDGAR search supplied the actual corroboration below.

validity.recommendation: No action -- existence, classification and non-duplicate status all confirmed.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE/CLASSIFICATION: confirmed real. EIA's 'Natural Gas Pipeline Projects' historical dataset (Historical Projects sheet, both the Jan-2022 and Jan-2023 editions) carries this exact project: Project Name 'Galveston County Project', Pipeline Operator Name 'Florida Gas Trans Co', Status 'Completed', Completed Date 2021-02-01, State TX, Docket Number CP20-505 (Authority: FERC), Project Type 'Lateral' / Pipeline Type 'Intrastate', Project Notes 'Install two pipeline segments on the FGT Mainline that connect to a natural gas power plant in Galveston, Texas', Demand Served 'Electric'. No Federal Register notice exists for CP20-505 -- checked via the FR API -- which is expected, not a red flag: a facility this small typically clears under a blanket-certificate 'prior notice' (18 CFR 157.205/157.208) with no individual FR publication. DUPLICATE CHECK: checked against the 45-pipeline TX-operating roster. P0190 ('Florida Gas Transmission Pipeline', Port Lavaca-to-Florida, ~8,529 mi) is the mainline aggregate row; P4051 is a Louisiana segment (~24.7 mi); P3296 is the 'Station 65' segment. All are distinct, differently-scoped GEM rows for the same larger FGT system -- consistent with GEM's known segment-based tracking of this pipeline family. No duplicate. CAVEAT: EIA lists Miles = 2.6 for this project vs. GEM's LengthKnown = 3.00 mi (~15% difference) -- see the separate spec concern below; every other spec value (capacity, diameter, cost) matches EIA exactly.

validity.recommendation: Correct StartYear1 from 2022 to 2021. This also plausibly bears on the Delayed/DelayType flag (Delayed='yes', DelayType='inferred') -- if that inference was made against the (apparently wrong) 2022 date, it may need re-checking once StartYear1 is corrected. Not resolved independently here; leaving Delay [ref] UNRESOLVED rather than guessing.
